meeting.body: Maui County Council Agriculture, Diversification, Environment, & Public Transportation Committee
meeting.voteItem: Amendment to section F on where the five-year updated plan is submitted
meeting.summary: The committee recommended passing Bill 98, which would establish a Food and Nutrition Security Plan, with six ayes and one member excused.
meeting.recap: The only item was Bill 98, which would establish a Food and Nutrition Security Plan.[[0:03:36]] The chair said a 2024 survey found 60 percent of Maui County residents and 70 percent of fire survivors cut back on groceries for money reasons.[[0:04:27]] The Department of Agriculture director said the department supports adding the plan to the county code.[[0:10:19]] A speaker for the Maui County Farm Bureau asked the committee to delay the bill so producers could suggest changes.[[0:20:33]] The speaker said the Farm Bureau does not want to stop the bill and hopes to weigh in before a later reading.[[0:23:08]] The chair called for a motion to recommend passing Bill 98 on first reading.[[1:24:19]] Members voted to have each five-year plan update sent to the council instead of the county.[[1:27:10]] That motion, as amended, passed with six ayes and one member excused.[[1:32:20]]
decided: The committee approved changing the bill so each five-year updated plan is submitted to the council instead of the county.
meeting.next: The chair said first reading of the bill happens at the full council. The chair said there is a chance to make changes at first and second reading. Department staff said they will share an annual progress update on the dashboard.
